atAGlance: Bánh tráng nướng is grilled rice paper “pizza”, usually with egg, scallion, dried shrimp or sausage, chili sauce, and crackle.
whatItIs: Bánh tráng nướng is grilled rice paper cooked until crisp with egg, scallions, dried shrimp or sausage, chili, and mayonnaise-style or savory toppings. It is often nicknamed Vietnamese pizza.
howToEnjoy: Eat it hot before the rice paper loses its crackle. Say no chili before the vendor sauces the top, because the spice gets baked into the snack.
howLocalsOrder: Order bánh tráng nướng by topping if the stall offers choices. Ask for no chili, no dried shrimp, or extra egg before it hits the grill.
worthKnowing: This is a street-snack texture dish: thin rice paper turns brittle and smoky, while egg and toppings make it savory enough to share.
goodToKnow: Often called “Vietnamese pizza,” but expect rice paper, egg, dried shrimp or sausage, scallions, and chili rather than cheese-heavy pizza.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bánh tráng nướng.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of grilled rice paper, Vietnamese pizza.
